key_features.classic_presentation: ONSET: Chronic from birth, acute exacerbations. LOCATION: Bilateral, diffuse. DURATION: Chronic with acute exacerbations. CHARACTER: Chronic productive cough, dyspnea. AGGRAVATING: Infections, thick secretions, dehydration. RELIEVING: Chest physiotherapy, mucolytics, antibiotics. TIMING: Chronic baseline with acute worsening. SEVERITY: Moderate to severe (5-9/10). ASSOCIATED SYMPTOMS: Chronic productive cough, recurrent infections, dyspnea, failure to thrive, salty skin, clubbing, sinusitis. KEY POSITIVES: Family history, chronic cough, recurrent infections, failure to thrive. KEY NEGATIVES: No chest pain (unless infection), no wheezing (unless reactive airway disease).

red_flags: Weight loss or failure to thrive
